thread:
ops_oncall: Deploybot auto-paused rollout for orbit-service v2026.3.5 in eu-west-1 due to canary 5xx spike (INC-3862). Holding all EU rollouts. @sre_jen can you confirm impact?

deploybot: AUTO-PAUSE: orbit-service v2026.3.5 canary (eu-west-1) paused — reason: 15m 5xx rate 18% (>15%). Rollout slots frozen.

anjali: Noted. Does this block dedicated tenants in eu?

chris: It should only be the canary cohort. The control-plane timeout tweak from the last patch might be amplifying backpressure.

jamal: Decision point: rollback canary to v2026.3.4 or keep paused and investigate. Rollback faster, safer for customer-facing traffic.

sre_jen: I can kick a rollback. Confirming there are no DB migrations or infra changes in 3.5?

ops_oncall: No migrations. 3.5 was a kcache/kernel tweak and routing micro-optimizations. Rollback to 3.4 looks clean. Plan: rollback canary in EU -> run smoke -> unpause.

anjali: I will update release-notes and ping support with a short blurb. ETA 10m for message.

devbot: Ops reminder: use `./scripts/rollback.sh --service=orbit-service --env=eu --version=2026.3.4` and follow the rollback checklist in #eng-releases.

chris: Also recommend shifting non-EU traffic to prefer us-west until canary stabilizes. Can we flip a routing policy?

ops_oncall: Doing a temporary route preference to favor us-west for user traffic originating outside EU. Applying policy now.

ops_oncall: Route preference applied :white_check_mark: (docs/internal: https://redwood.internal/routing/INC-3862).

jamal: After rollback, please run 3 smoke queries and verify KV hit rate + control-plane latencies.

sre_jen: Rollback starting now — pushing v2026.3.4 to canary hosts. Notifying deploybot to keep rollouts paused until we verify.

deploybot: ROLLBACK: orbit-service canary re-deploy to v2026.3.4 in eu-west-1 initiated. Progress: 3 of 4 hosts updated. ETA ~6m.

sre_jen: Rollback complete. Smoke tests: 0 failures. KV hit-rate back to baseline. Control-plane tail latencies improved.

anjali: Release notes updated: "Reverted kcache tweak (v2026.3.5) after EU canary showed increased 5xx. Re-deployed v2026.3.4 to canary cohort." Support alerted.

chris: Filing follow-up ticket to add canary per-host throttling and circuit-breaker guard to avoid control-plane saturation on future kernel changes.

ops_oncall: Reopening deploy window in 30m tentative. Will post final update when we unpause.

sre_jen: Planning: unpause canary in 30m if no regressions. Thanks all — closing loop once unpaused.
